title: Sky trail photographed near Harmon Field, Newfoundland, 10 July 1947 (Fig. 5)
description: Photograph of a cloudy sky with a dark diagonal trail or cleavage through the cloud formation, with a utility pole and tree tops along the bottom edge. The accompanying text describes Pan-American Airways mechanic Mr. Woodruff's report of a circular object leaving a trail that appeared as a "burning up" of the cloud formation, photographed by another PAA employee. Captioned "Fig. 5".
